usersTab.title: Users
usersTab.usageHint: Active accounts and open invitations take a place; deactivated accounts do not.
usersTab.limitBanner: The instance is full: no new invitation until you deactivate or delete an account, or revoke an invitation.
usersTab.selfHint: This is your account. Manage it from:

reasons.protected: This account is protected: nobody can deactivate, demote or delete it.
reasons.lastAdmin: It is the only active administrator: it cannot be deactivated or demoted.
reasons.limit: The instance is full: free a place to reactivate it.
reasons.demoteFirst: An administrator must be demoted before it can be deleted.
reasons.pendingSetup: It waits for its setup: it keeps its role until then.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {username}?
deactivate.message: The account can no longer sign in and every session ends. Its brokers and transactions stay: you can reactivate it later.

promote.title: Make {username} an administrator?
promote.message: Administrators manage the instance: its settings, its users and its invitations.

demote.title: Remove the administrator rights of {username}?
demote.message: The account stays, as a regular user, and its sessions end.

signOut.title: Sign {username} out everywhere?
signOut.message: Every session of the account ends: it must sign in again on each device.

restartGuides.title: Restart the guides of {username}?
restartGuides.message: The introduction and the page guides show again, as for a new account.

revokeInvite.title: Revoke the invitation for {email}?
revokeInvite.message: The link stops working at once.

cancelSetup.title: Cancel the setup link of {username}?
cancelSetup.message: The link already handed over stops working. The account keeps waiting for its setup: a new link comes from «dev.py user setup-link» on the server, or from your hosting provider.

errors.LAST_ADMIN: The last active administrator can be neither deactivated nor demoted.
errors.USER_LIMIT_REACHED: The instance is full: free a place first (deactivate or delete an account, or revoke an invitation).
errors.REGISTRATION_DISABLED: Registration is closed: no invitation can be created.
errors.ACCOUNT_PROTECTED: This account is protected: nobody can deactivate, demote or delete it.
errors.SELF_DELETION: Delete your own account from the Profile tab.
errors.DEMOTE_FIRST: An administrator must be demoted before it can be deleted.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This account no longer exists: the list is reloaded.
errors.DELETION_FAILED: The deletion failed: nothing was deleted.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check what you entered: the e-mail address may not be valid.
errors.load: The accounts could not be loaded.
errors.PENDING_SETUP: This administrator waits for its setup: it can be neither reactivated nor demoted here.
errors.SETUP_COMPLETED: This administrator completed its setup in the meantime: nothing was changed.
errors.LAST_ADMIN_DELETION: You are the last active administrator: make another account an administrator before deleting yours.
